title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated low-privilege client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing authorization checks to be performed under that other client's identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows. The flaw arises because OAuthlib does not require the authenticated client's client_id to match the client_id used for grant and scope validation, allowing token issuance with unauthorized scopes or grant types. The issue requires the attacker to have valid credentials for a lower-privilege client and depends on the application's validator using the client_id argument for authorization. A fix is available in version 4.5.1_14.
